findings.description: swap() returns router.exchange(...)'s return value verbatim with no balanceOf(msg.sender) before/after delta and no amountOut >= minAmountOut re-check; the market strategy then safeTransfers that reported amount onward. findings.description: setSlippageTolerance accepts _bps == MAX_BPS. At that value every minOut collapses to 0 (deposit: convertToShares(creditedPrincipal=0); exits: ideal*(0)/MAX_BPS), removing all sandwich protection on AMM swaps of the full position, and deposits credit zero principal. Owner-set, but the setter's only bound is <= MAX_BPS so the degenerate value is accepted silently; plausible footgun (Law 3) rather than malicious-owner vector. Default 0 means the opposite extreme (zero tolerance -> any AMM spread reverts). Story-051 removal did not change this.
missingMitigations: No sane upper cap below MAX_BPS on slippageToleranceBps
mitigationsPresent: minOut reference is vault NAV (convertToAssets), not AMM spot, so the bound is not self-referential when bps < MAX_BPS

findings.description: Principal credit and NAV use fee-free convertToAssets (deliberately, for STATICCALL safety on Tokemak Autopools) instead of previewRedeem; withdraw sizes shares with floor convertToShares instead of round-up previewWithdraw. Rounding direction itself is protocol-favouring (no profitable 1-wei loop found: withdrawer gets <= amount, principal written down by the requested amount), but on a fee-charging vault the credited principal / totalBalanceOf over-state redeemable value. With previewExitFor removed (story-051), there is no longer a published guarantee built on this value, so the L-19 framing is gone; the underlying fee-blind NAV persists.
mitigationsPresent: Round-down favours protocol on both legs

manualReview.description: Skipped-pattern HM twist (Law 3 footgun). The live mainnet CurveAMMAdapter 0x2D02...D6f is immutable and predates the story-052 contiguity validator; it is held as immutable ammAdapter by YieldStrategyUSDe. Any owner setRoute on it still runs the old 'last non-zero == tokenOut' check, so the sya-harvester M-01 gapped route [USDe,pool,crvUSD,0,...,sUSDe] would be accepted there, and Router NG would stop at the first gap and deliver crvUSD to the strategy (stranding value / reverting on _expected). A competent owner reading the new source would reasonably assume the check is live everywhere - surprise => footgun. Not a code defect at HEAD; an operational hazard: verify routes off-chain against the new rule before any mainnet setRoute, or redeploy adapter + strategy.
manualReview.whyLow: Pattern applicability (centralization) is indirect; hazard is deployment-state, not HEAD code. Severity if realised could be Medium (stranded swap output on a live strategy).

manualReview.description: Route-misconfiguration residuals after story-052 (corroborates profiler LOCAL-001/LOCAL-002, dedup should collapse): (a) no explicit tokenIn != tokenOut check - a cyclic or i==j 1-hop self-route passes and one call satisfies the bidirectional gate (routes[A][A] is both directions); (b) swap_type validated as a denylist {0,9} rather than Router NG allowlist {1..8}, so a value >= 10 stores a route that reverts on every swap, freezing deposit/withdraw/skim until overwritten; (c) swap_params i/j vs path tokens not checkable on-chain (T-3). All owner-authored and recoverable by overwrite.
manualReview.whyLow: Not a DB pattern proper; owner-authored config. Strategies never call swap(x,x).

manualReview.description: minOut for share sales is derived from live vault.convertToAssets at execution. If the vault rate moves up (sUSDe reward vesting, or a donation to the vault) faster than the AMM price follows, or the AMM structurally trades the share below NAV (sUSDe cooldown discount), NAV*(1-bps) exceeds achievable AMM output and every exit/skim reverts until the owner widens tolerance. Donation-driven variant requires gifting to all vault holders (expensive for sUSDe). This is hand-off H-A; the sandwich/value-leak framing was adjudicated false-positive (M-02 d7f6c2dfd580, M-01-run12 fdda8f53151a - memory: do not re-escalate). L-22 7a66fe7d5a96 ('quoted floor not honoured') lost its premise with story-051; if this DoS variant is filed, it is a distinct root cause and needs a fresh entry with disclosure.
manualReview.whyLow: Needs target-vault + pool behaviour (cross-contract); owner can recover via setSlippageTolerance.

manualReview.description: Direct strategy calls vault.deposit(amount) with only a sharesReceived > 0 check and no minShares bound. If the owner-chosen target vault is empty/young and lacks virtual-share protection, a classic inflation (first-depositor donation) on the target vault rounds the strategy's shares down; the strategy then credits convertToAssets(sharesReceived), so the loss lands on the depositing client. The strategy itself mints no shares, so the literal DB signatures do not match. Strategy-level donation (sending shares to the strategy) only inflates surplus (gift), not a loss.
manualReview.whyLow: Target vaults are owner-chosen mature vaults (autoDOLA etc.); not exploitable without an empty, unprotected target. Note CFG-01 0c12a2cfaf4b already flags a wrong autoDOLA address.

manualReview.description: underlyingToken.safeTransferFrom(depositor, this, amount) is followed by crediting _creditedPrincipal(amount) and approving/swapping `amount` with no balance delta. A fee-on-transfer underlying would over-credit / revert in the adapter pull. Underlying is a single immutable owner-chosen token (USDe/DOLA class), not permissionless, so generic FoT is OOS per C4; preserved only for completeness.
manualReview.whyLow: Underlying is fixed at construction and non-FoT; C4 known-invalid unless FoT in scope.
